description: This PHP class 'PurgeCandidateListModel' is a model in the 'OrangeHRM' Human Resource Management system, specifically within the Maintenance API. It implements the 'Normalizable' interface to transform Candidate entity data into an array suitable for API responses, representing candidate information such as name, application date, and status.

classes.name: PurgeCandidateListModel
classes.description: A model class that serializes Candidate entity data into a schema-compliant array for API responses, encapsulating candidate details and status.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with a Candidate entity.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the Candidate entity data into an associative array for API serialization, including handling vacancy status.
